turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; start there.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear from Owen before it went into the gradebook?
But I'm not changing the grade.

"Not changing the grade." On what basis, Hale, because your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish anything, and I haven't heard you mention anything else. If that's all you have, I'm going straight to the principal's office when I leave this room.
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.

I'm writing that down: still no basis given, and still no answer on whether Owen was heard first. Procedure 4.2 says I get a call before any mark is entered, and I got a gradebook notification instead. Last chance, Hale: what else do you have, or do I go upstairs?
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.

Then I'll want that refusal in an email tonight, with whatever you based the zero on. I'm going to the principal's office from here, and if that goes nowhere, the board. One more thing for my notes, Hale: is anything on Owen's record right now?
